The mock session user has `id: 'dev:local-admin'`, `instanceId: 'de-musterhausen'`, `roles: ['system_admin']`. There's no `name` field — which confirms why the smoke contract's `payload.user?.name !== 'Builder Mock User'` fails.

Now let me exercise the actual dev-auth flow end-to-end with curl:
1. GET /auth/login → expect redirect to `/?auth=dev-login&returnTo=...`
2. POST /auth/dev-login (with the dev-auth cookie) → expect redirect to returnTo with `sva_dev_auth=1` cookie set
3. GET /auth/me with `sva_dev_auth=1` cookie → expect 200 with the mock user
4. GET /api/v1/iam/me/context with the cookie → expect 200/401/403
